notes.title: 27 June Update Notes
notes.notes:
Fixes:
- Fixed laser visibility in third person
- Fixed uncrouch not possible on clients
- Fixed crouching animation when a player joins a session and there is already someone crouching in.

Global:
- Added blue laser to X12 pistol

Improvements:
- Improved performance and code 
- Improved map layout for 2vs2 map.

notes.title: 26 June Update Notes
notes.notes:
Fixes:
- Fixed player not able to slide when high ping (not optimal).
- Fixed weapon visibility when high ping.
- Fixed maximum bot numbers.
- Fixed weird bots movement.

Global:
- Added 2vs2 gamemode, plays in 6 round.

Improvements:
- Cleaned code -> 1 or 2 fps boost.

notes.title: 25 June Update Notes Bis
notes.notes:
Fixes :
- Fixed ability to do glitches in stairs.
- Fixed ability to do glitches in mid-map ramp.
- Fixed a bug where the player couldn't change weapon in third person
- Fixed float score in leaderboard.

Global
- Added settings to toggle / hold aiming.
- Added settings to toggle / hold crouching.
- Added interpolation for clients movement (not optimal yet).
- Added settings for inpsect key.

Know bugs
- Due to ping on clients there is a small delay where you can see the first person weapon in third person.
- Clients rotation are not fully replicated which can cause a really disturbing effect.

- Fixed client able to see mag reserve.

notes.title: 22 June Update Notes
notes.notes:
Fixes:
- Sniper scope being not replicated on clients.
- Character's rotation being not correctly reset to zero after performing slides.
- Bots not shooting on their first spawn.

Know Bugs:
- Rocket launcher's rocket being not replicated on clients (temporary fix : disabled for now.)
- Bots are too strong in Free-For-All gamemode.
- Steam controller inputs override in-game ones so you need to setup steam controller inputs.
